newsitem.title: POLAND: LDA PLANS TO NET PLN 1.6 MLN IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: LDA PLANS TO NET PLN 1.6 MLN IN 1997.

text.p: Polish printing house Lodzka Drukarnia Akcydensowa SA (LDA) expects to make a net profit of 1.6 million zlotys next year on sales of about 46 million zlotys, the financial daily Parkiet reported on Thursday.
The papar cited LDA's president as saying the firm would record a net profit of 1.1 million zlotys this year on sales of 33 million zlotys.
Over the first three quarters this year the firm has earned 0.7 million zlotys on sales of 22.9 million after earning 0.5 million zlotys last year on sales of 26.8 million zlotys.
